# Literature review

This replay fixture runs without a literature search (no references are added to the study). The draft therefore cites no work, and the citation check reports that the study has no references.

The descriptive question (how planet radii are distributed, and how radius varies with orbital period) is a standard one in exoplanet demographics; a real study of archive data would situate its description in that literature. For this synthetic test sample, the review states only what the study does: it describes the sample and compares nothing with published distributions.
